semiconductor_relevance: High — Saultech specializes in advanced packaging equipment, particularly in die bonding and sorting technologies critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Saultech Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on high-yield bonders and sorters for advanced packaging applications. They provide precision die bonding and sorting solutions, addressing the industry's need for extreme alignment accuracy and high throughput in high-volume manufacturing.
capabilities: Advanced sorting solutions with vision alignment
Hybrid bonding technology with active vibration isolation
Non-destructive peeling technology for thin dies
